walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 2: Popular Culture (Free-time Activities; Customs, Festivals and Celebrations; Celebrity Culture) — a core area of GCSE German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 2: Popular Culture (Free-time Activities; Customs, Festivals and Celebrations; Celebrity Culture) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 2: Popular Culture (Free-time Activities; Customs, Festivals and Celebrations; Celebrity Culture).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence correctly means 'I watch TV every evening'?
options: Ich sehe jeden Abend fern.
Ich fernsehe jeden Abend.
Ich sehe fern jeden Abend.
Ich jeden Abend fernsehe.

mcqs.q: Which auxiliary verb does 'gehen' use in the perfect tense?
options: sein
haben
werden
mögen

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I like to play football' in German?
options: Ich gebrauche mein Phone jeden Tag.
Ich mag spielen Fußball.
Ich spiele gern Fußball.
Ich liebe Fußball spielen.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I use my phone every day' in German?
options: Ich benutze mein Handy jeden Tag.
Ich gebrauche mein Phone jeden Tag.
Ich liebe Fußball spielen.
Ich nutze mein Telefon jeden Tag.

mcqs.q: What is the German word for 'Christmas'?
options: Weihnachten (singular plural form).
Wenachten (omitting the h).
Ich liebe Fußball spielen.
Christmas (with English spelling).
